reason: I don't walk into a new store until I've read what other women say about it, and on opening week there are no Google reviews to read. Five minutes from Hillcroft is fine, but I'd wait a month or two, see the ratings and photos, and maybe join the Ramadan list in the meantime.
objection: A brand-new boutique with no reviews: I don't know if the embroidery holds up after a wash or if the 'free exchange' is easy in practice or a hassle at the counter.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a solid Google Maps rating with real customer comments and photos of the thobes after washing, or a friend from my community telling me she bought there and was happy.
